restaurantName: Zheng Qing Niu Rou Guo Tie Dian
address: 2-1 Jiangxi Road, Gulou, Nanjing, Chinese Mainland
bio: For almost 40 years, this small halal shop has won the hearts of locals with its well-made beef dishes. Potstickers are the must-try, seducing with crisp charred bottom, plump juicy beef filling and tempting scallion aromas. Beef wontons are little bombs bursting with meaty umami in a translucent velvety skin, served in a peppery beef broth. Other braised beef cuts and offal are also flavoursome, tender, and just the ticket with all kinds of noodles.
pageTitle: Zheng Qing Niu Rou Guo Tie Dian
